rows: Errol Jay E DePaz (QA Engineer / Developer)

blocks.text: This test plan describes the approach, scope, schedule, and resources for testing the VentSpace web application — an anonymous venting/journaling platform built with React + Vite (frontend) and Express + Supabase (backend). The application features a feed with mood filters, a postcard creator and wall, a map with community notes, and an admin panel for content moderation.

The goal is to ensure all features work correctly across supported browsers, that the user experience is smooth and intuitive, and that security measures (rate limiting, input sanitization, admin authentication) function as expected before production release.

blocks.text: Testing will follow a structured manual testing approach supplemented by automated Playwright end-to-end tests.

rows: Verify all pages load and core navigation works
Visual correctness, responsive layout, theme toggle
Invalid inputs, empty fields, boundary values, XSS attempts
Admin auth, rate limiting, input sanitization, blacklisted words
Ensure new changes don't break existing features
Keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, ARIA labels

items: Positive testing: valid inputs, expected user flows
Negative testing: invalid inputs, boundary values, error handling
Equivalence partitioning: grouping inputs into valid/invalid classes
Boundary value analysis: min/max character limits, rate limit thresholds
Exploratory testing: unscripted navigation to discover edge cases
